finalText:
**Three breaking changes hide in the refactors.** Draft is in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).

An expired token now returns `401`, not `403`. Five modules stopped re-exporting internal error types. The v1 export route is gone. One real feature: webhook retries with backoff. The rest is 10 fixes. One stops the request body reaching logs.

Next: confirm nobody calls the v1 export route. `docs: note the minimum node version` landed five times. Check if `engines` moved too.
